headlines.title: Economy, court fights and Dem chaos: Final days of the 2026 midterm race
headlines.description: With 73% of voters dissatisfied with the economy, candidates made their final pitches ahead of the 2026 midterm elections. President Trump campaigned in Iowa and Kansas while Democrats clashed in Michigan. NBC News' Maggie Vespa reports.

headlines.title: Go Behind the Scenes of NBC News’ Decision Desk
headlines.description: TODAY’s Savannah Guthrie goes behind-the-scenes with the NBC News team tasked with calling election night’s pivotal races from coast-to-coast.

headlines.title: Federal investigators on scene of Florida plane crash that killed 9 people
headlines.description: Nine people were killed as a Learjet nosedived and crashed in Palm Beach County, Florida. NBC News' Jesse Kirsch reports on where the NTSB's investigation stands.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy in court as defense seeks to block retrial in murder case
headlines.description: A judge on Monday ruled that he will determine later this month whether Lindsay Clancy, the Massachusetts woman accused of killing her three children in 2023, will face a retrial on three murder counts.

headlines.title: Study links energy drinks to risk of cardiac arrest
headlines.description: New research presented at the American Heart Association’s annual meeting found that cardiac arrest was higher among those who consumed energy drinks and supplements. NBC News’ Berkeley Lovelace Jr. explains which types of stimulants to watch out for.

headlines.title: Fake alerts warn of nuclear danger as Ukraine and Russia report emergency app hacks
headlines.description: Nuclear danger, radiation threat and street combat: Ukrainians received a wave of messages Sunday night that raised alarm with a series of grave — and baseless — warnings.

headlines.title: Supermarkets across Europe hit by new fridge cyberattacks
headlines.description: Supermarkets across Europe were hit Monday by a new wave of apparent cyberattacks affecting fridges and freezers.

headlines.title: Democrats in key battlegrounds throw Joe Biden under the bus on the border
headlines.description: Democratic candidates in 2026 battleground races are criticizing Joe Biden’s handling of border security, seeking to neutralize a political vulnerability.

headlines.title: ‘Looks like Mars’: Toxic smog from Indonesia wildfires sparks health crisis, protests
headlines.description: Wildfires in Indonesia are blanketing the country and other southeast Asian nations in toxic smog, prompting widespread protests.

headlines.title: Affording America: For a traveling carnival, rising costs mean a bumpy ride
headlines.description: Blake Huston is a third generation carnival operator who has been around the business all his life. But rising gas, labor and insurance costs are all taking a toll on his bottom line and threatening the industry he calls a way of life.

headlines.title: Jet may have experienced ‘some breakup’ before it crashed in Florida, killing 9, NTSB says
headlines.description: Officials said there may have been “some breakup” of the Learjet 60 before it crashed Sunday afternoon in Palm Beach County, Florida, killing all nine people on board.

headlines.title: Ahead of Election Day, Trump sets the stage for potential Republican losses
headlines.description: In an election-eve speech at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool, President Donald Trump said that Republicans “gave this a very strong shot,” while acknowledging that historically, the president’s party “doesn’t win the midterms.”
